args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE NEW landscape1536x1024 transparent PNG KFB character sheet, EXACTLY SIX unique Roman legion ink blob monsters in THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS.
Input1 STYLE ONLY: rounded complete dark charcoal-violet ink body, rich plasticine modeling, thick sculpted lids, soft handmade volumes. Input2 STYLE ONLY: beautifully crafted clay metal, wood, cloth, leather props. Do not edit or copy these actual characters. Fresh original six-person Roman troupe, not reskins of another soldier sheet.
Style: weird absurd-surreal cartoon-claymation Roman soldiers, different ranks and specialisms with strong character acting. Rounded bronze/iron helmets, red cloth, segmented armor accents, leather straps, weathered wood and selective gold, no environment. All armor/costume partial so the whole goo creature remains dominant. Two female-read characters, conveyed subtly by lids/lashes and character design, no human anatomy. No real person likeness, lettering, SPQR text, labels or flags.
Anatomy: each ONE CONTINUOUS COMPLETE UPRIGHT FOOTLESS black ink splat with subtle deep-purple sheen, thick asymmetric soft rounded lobes, face directly in body, short goo hands, a few detached droplets kept inside its cell. No human torso/legs/feet, bust, fur body, angular rock or pointy spines. Keep handmade rich soft plasticine, delicate fingerprints, modeled seams and restrained wear. Offbeat sculptural cartoon acting, not generic Pixar mascot smiles.
Eyes ALL: WHITE/IVORY sclera, distinct small RED IRIS, BLACK PUPIL, thick fully violet-black clay lids. No all-red glowing eyes. Six visibly different mouth shapes, lip weights, brow arrangements, gaze and emotional attitude; irregular ivory teeth where shown. No six repeated angry grins or protruding tongues.

TOP LEFT — MALE-READ CENTURION. Very broad low barrel blob, huge thick side lobes, squat bronze helmet with short RED TRANSVERSE crest running ear-to-ear. Barking affront at peak breath: one eye compressed low, other wide and staring forward, violently unequal brows, skewed rectangular open mouth with three offset teeth and heavy lower lip. Holds ONE short thick GLADIUS upright low beside body, simple steel blade, round wooden grip visibly in hand. Red shoulder scrap and two modest bronze armor bands, no full human cuirass.
TOP MIDDLE — FEMALE-READ OPTIO. Tall slender hooked pear blob with looped crown lobe, modest iron helmet with two compact red side feathers, subtle lashes. Cool knowingly mischievous side-eye, one eyelid high, opposite lowered, closed crooked smile with single small offset upper tooth. One hand rests over a stout upright wooden STAFF with large round knob, other goo hand on own side. Staff stays alongside and within cell, not pointing at another actor. Small brown scale-armor shoulder panel.
TOP RIGHT — MALE-READ AQUILIFER / EAGLE STANDARD BEARER. Round top-heavy asymmetrical splat, a broad goofy bronze lion-face helmet cap with rounded clay ears, no furry creature anatomy. Deep sincere WORRY, eyes looking up at his own standard, inner brows lifted, sagging lip pinched into an anxious closed underbite with two lower teeth. Clutches ONE SHORT gold eagle standard against body: chunky simple eagle with two wings and a bent head perched on stubby thick pole. Not a long flagpole, no text. Weight of honor feels personally inconvenient.
BOTTOM LEFT — MALE-READ CORNICEN / HORN SIGNALER. Tall bent kidney-shaped blob with a prominent downward side lobe, plain dull iron helmet and one small blue cloth neck scrap. Worn-out unimpressed expression, very heavy lowered white eyes looking sideways and enormous projecting pout, mouth almost closed with one tiny tooth. Holds ONE large rounded G-shaped BRONZE CORNU HORN across his own lower body, simple continuous circular tube with a clear flared bell and a single short crossbrace. Horn NOT played; free hand loosely cradles its bell. Whole horn inside cell. Not a repeated puff-cheek bugler.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — MALE-READ ORDINARY LEGIONARY. Short wide upright dumpling splat with three fat crown drops, dented simple iron helmet crooked over one eye, red neck fold. Absurd bewildered determination: huge white eyes peering DOWN around one large rounded lobe, one raised brow and one scrunched lid, tightly clenched uneven ivory teeth with raised lower lip. A rounded RED RECTANGULAR CURVED SCUTUM shield with bronze central boss is held close to one side, covers less than half his body; ONE shortened stout PILUM held vertically on other side, simple wooden shaft and steel tip within cell. The props seem almost too official for their nervous owner. Keep whole blob visible and footless.
BOTTOM RIGHT — FEMALE-READ TRIBUNE. Broad upright wavy-edged diamond-shaped soft splat, two small curled upper lobes, ornamental bronze helmet with short swept-back IVORY crest, muted purple shoulder sash. Strained diplomatic politeness at its limit: unequal wide white eyes glancing sideways, brows lifted unequally, stretched very shallow crooked grin with two widely separated ivory teeth, tense cheek fold. Holds ONE small hinged wood-framed WAX TABLET open across her lower body and ONE fat short wooden STYLUS in the other hand. Wax plain, no marks/text. No full robes, human torso or legs.

Layout: six large complete self-contained actors in a visually regular 3x2 grid. Similar substantial BODY HEIGHT across both rows, clothing never replaces blob form. Each whole silhouette approx450-480px tall inside512px cell with safe transparent margins. Contain all crests, swords, staff, standard, horn, shield, pilum, tablet and droplets; no touching/overlap of neighboring actors. Do not make tiny bottom-row figures. No visible gridlines, scenery, floor, ground, shadow discs, background gradient, checkerboard, halos, text or watermark. Real transparent alpha-zero background and opaque character interiors, clean antialiased edges. Soft upper-left studio lighting on character volumes only.
